shot: SL-09 short 5 (Oura Ring Or WHOOP?) idea J2, R4 WHOOP version: ring and WHOOP strap on one hand, 9:16, about 6.8 s, over 'Oura Ring and WHOOP are my top two options ... wrist-based or a finger-based sleep tracker' (0:13.8-0:20.6)
start_frame: J2w_start.png (1080x1920; boxes in START pixels). Both frames were generated at 941x1672 by Codex and resized to 1080x1920 (same aspect, Lanczos); raw files J2w_start_raw.png, J2w_end_raw.png. START is an edit of the approved R3 J2 START with only the band replaced.
intent: Close-up from above of a man's right forearm and hand on a light wooden desk in daylight. On the wrist a WHOOP-style screenless tracker: a black knit strap with a small rectangular matte charcoal sensor pod on TOP of the wrist, facing the camera. A matte black smart ring on the index finger. The hand starts palm-down, fingers open and relaxed; it lifts a little off the desk at the wrist and tilts slightly toward the camera so ring and pod catch the light (the raised index finger enters the band of window light on the desk), then lowers back. Fingers stay open throughout; the ring stays on the index finger; the pod stays on top of the wrist; the forearm stays on the desk; the desk, light and camera do not move. This take was made from the approved START frame only (no END frame): Veo could not close this hand into the approved fist without a finger flicking up (four takes).

hands.right: the only hand in shot: open palm-down in START, a relaxed loose fist in END; the ring on its index finger and the WHOOP strap with its pod on top of the wrist in both frames

take_note: J2 take 5 (J2-api-t5.mp4), START only; edit uses seconds 0.4-4.7 (frames 10-113).
